whenToUse: Filters by range, such as a price band, area, or period.
People quickly try rough ranges and watch the results.
Both ends of the range are fixed.
whenNotToUse: An exact range must be entered (use two number fields).
Only one end needs setting (use a slider).
The range is so wide that handles are hard to adjust.
accessibility: Each handle is its own range input, so each can be moved with the keyboard.
Names distinguish "Minimum price" from "Maximum price", and aria-valuetext reads the unit.
The handles can't pass each other, so the range never flips.
The current range is also shown in words.
